You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I got stuck in an infinite loop trying to retrieve the ice wand from the magic workshop ceiling, ignoring the fact that I already had the apple in my inventory and needed to drop it to make space for the borpulus (which I had already acquired earlier but failed to pick up due to inventory limits). My strategy was reactive and disorganized; I should have first checked my inventory status before attempting to take new items. Next time, I will: 1) Immediately drop the apple in the kitchen after putting it in the cauldron to free up inventory space. 2) Return to the storage room to pick up the borpulus while I have space. 3) Only then proceed to the magic workshop to get the ice wand, ensuring I have all required tools (ectoplasm, borpulus, ice wand) before attempting the final steps. I will also track my inventory count mentally to avoid the "two objects" error.

Trial #2: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly entered a loop between the storage room and the kitchen, attempting to swap items (apple, borpulus, ice wand) without ever executing the actual brewing steps. I got stuck trying to manage inventory space by dropping items back and forth instead of clearing the cauldron first. Next time, I will: 1) Immediately go to the storage room, take the borpulus, and return to the kitchen. 2) Before taking any more ingredients, I will explicitly execute the recipe steps in order: stir the cauldron with the borpulus, then add the remaining ingredients (ectoplasm, spider egg, peach) one by one, dropping items from inventory as needed to make space. 3) Only after the cauldron contains all ingredients will I proceed to the final step (waving the ice wand) and then say "> done". I will avoid unnecessary travel loops by planning the full sequence of actions before moving between rooms.

New plan: I failed because I repeatedly attempted to "take" ectoplasm without first locating it, ignoring the game description that placed it on the "ingredient rack" in the pantry. I also got stuck in a loop trying to manage inventory space by dropping items back and forth instead of executing the recipe steps in the correct order. Next time, I will: 1) Immediately go to the pantry and interact with the "ingredient rack" to retrieve the ectoplasm (using the correct verb if necessary, e.g., "take ectoplasm from ingredient rack" or simply "take ectoplasm" if the rack is treated as a container). 2) Once I have the ectoplasm, borpulus, and ice wand, I will go to the kitchen and execute the recipe steps strictly in order: pour ectoplasm, stir with borpulus, add apple, wave ice wand, add spider egg, add peach. 3) I will only drop items from my inventory if I am certain I have already completed the step requiring them or if I am moving to a new room where I cannot use them immediately, rather than dropping them prematurely to make space for items I haven't found yet.
